stem: Maginot Line exists between which countries?
expl: The Maginot Line was a massive system of fortifications constructed by France before the Second World War to prevent a possible German attack. It was mainly built along France’s eastern border facing Germany, and partly towards Luxembourg.

Israel is a Mediterranean coastal country located in the Middle East of West Asia. Its western boundary is the Mediterranean Sea, the northern boundary lies with Lebanon, the north-eastern boundary with Syria, the eastern boundary with Jordan, and the south-western boundary with Egypt. Israel also shares boundaries with the disputed regions of the Gaza Strip and the West Bank.

stem: Which of the following countries does not have a land border with the Dead Sea?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: The Dead Sea is a salt lake bordered by Jordan to the east and Israel and Palestine to the west. Lebanon is located to the north of Israel and does not share a border with the Dead Sea.

stem: Which one of the following countries is the largest country without borders in terms of geographical area?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: A country whose land is not connected to the land of any other country is called an island country. Such a country is surrounded by the sea on all sides. Among the given options, Japan is the largest island country by geographical area, covering approximately 377,975 square kilometres. It is followed by the Philippines (300,000 sq. km.), New Zealand (268,838 sq. km.), and Cuba (1,10,860 sq. km.).
